$comment: Machine-readable design record for the strata-modern build. Human narrative is DESIGN.md; product truth is PRODUCT.md.

world.name: AGENDA — the AGM notice pack
world.premise: The incumbent's own subject matter is the agenda paper: a bound notice pack a strata manager assembles, punches, circulates and files. Every page is a sheet on a desk.
generatedByWorld: the punch margin and its folio rail
the double head-rule of a printed schedule
index tabs cut into a sheet edge
one highlighter sweep on the operative words
a perforated back cover and a slip of paper for the cookie notice

color._note: The brand is two colours and nothing else. logo-full.png was decoded pixel by pixel and contains exactly #094BC1 blue (54.1%) and #00544E teal (45.7%). Every accent below is one of those two; every ground is a value the incumbent site actually ships.

desk.role: the desk the sheets sit on; page background only

sheet2.role: second sheet / recessed print area (inputs, hover rows)

ink2.role: secondary text; the site's own value

ink3.role: tertiary text and annotations; the site's #69727D one step down so it also clears AA on --sheet-2

blue.role: the logo, 54%. Links, focus rings, the live control, the stamps, the single primary action.

teal.role: the logo, 46%. The record voice: secondary action, clause and record numbers, the Plus line, the accreditation seals.

tealSoft.role: form labels and fact keys; the site's own accent

marker.role: the highlighter; brand teal lifted into a wash. One sweep per sheet.

_retired._note: An earlier revision invented a vermilion #C8341F for stamps and the primary action, a yellow #F2E14C highlighter and a gold #BE894A for the seals. None of the three appears in the logo or in the incumbent's stylesheet. All were replaced with the brand's own blue and teal, and assets/marker.svg was recoloured to match.

structure._note: The sheet is calc(100% - 26px): a 13px reveal either side, and nothing more. No content block inside it is capped — rules, bands, schedules and the footer run the full width while prose keeps its 68ch measure. Measured fill of the viewport: 96.5% at 1024px, 97.5% at 1440px, 98.1% at 1920px, 98.6% at 2560px.

fit.method: tools/measure-fit.html measures all 40 pages in iframes, sequentially, one viewport per Chrome invocation (?v=WxH). It reports horizontal overflow plus the widest contributing element, document height in screens, word count, and how much of the viewport the sheet covers.
bugsFixed: .bar__cta was flex:none and no media query removed it, so all 40 pages overflowed by 281px at 390px; it is now hidden below 980px, where the drawer carries the same action
the twelve-column grids have eleven 30px gaps = 330px of gap alone, wider than a 320px phone; replaced by one --col-gap token that scales with the viewport
a single mailto: address, unbreakable and sitting in a grid, set the floor for the entire footer; addresses and URLs now use overflow-wrap:anywhere, which also shrinks min-content size
wide schedules are laid out to a fixed width below 640px so cells wrap rather than pushing the sheet sideways

the asset pruner unlinked anything no page referenced, so moving the platform wall off the home page deleted all twelve platform logos from disk; it now reports "present but unreferenced" and leaves the files alone

homeRelayout.method: tools/measure-blocks.ps1 loads one page and reports each top-level block's height in screens, plus the computed padding and border of any selector's children. Written to locate which section was making the home page long instead of guessing.
homeRelayout.note: The page is an overview: the hero, eight short sections on the incumbent's own order, and a 0.7-screen footer. It does not reach four screens without dropping sections the incumbent's own site carries, so the reported figure is 7.0 rather than a claim of 4.
defectsExposed: The .resolution navy closing band and its whole style block existed, app.js was listening for .stamp--settle, and the home page emitted an empty <section> in its place: the signature interaction had never rendered.

The folio rail counted [data-item], the printed item number, so on an unnumbered page it found nothing and left the static "01 / 01" placeholder on screen. It now counts section.item and reports the index.

optionsList emitted an empty .opt__no span for rows without a number, so four children went into a three-column plain grid and the arrow wrapped to an implicit second row: role rows rendered at 220-270px instead of 72px.
The figures band was placed in .wrap, itself a twelve-column grid, without grid-column: 1 / -1, so it resolved to a single minmax(190px,1fr) track and stacked its three figures vertically.

signatureInteraction.what: A range input on a printed ruler that rebuilds the post register from an inline JSON pool and updates four live readouts.
signatureInteraction.noJsBehaviour: register renders its first five posts statically; nothing is hidden

accessibility.headingOrder: one h1, then h2 per item, then h3; footer column titles are h3 so no level is skipped
accessibility.focus: visible :focus-visible rings on strata blue; drawer restores focus on close
accessibility.drawer: inert while closed, aria-expanded toggled, Escape to close
accessibility.forms: front-end only, inline field errors with role=alert, success in role=status; demo notice shown

reasons.numbered-section-labels: The agenda numbers are the notice pack's own item numbering and the sequence is referenced by the proxy form and the folio rail. Numbers that carried no information were removed from two lists.
reasons.all-caps-body: Uppercase is confined to control and record labels (buttons, footer legal, breadcrumbs, table headers). Every uppercase full sentence was removed.
reasons.gpt-thin-border-wide-shadow: A 1px-bordered sheet of paper lifted off a desk. The shadow is offset with a large negative spread and is neutral black.
reasons.marketing-buzzword: The phrase occurs inside a client's verbatim testimonial. Editing a client's language to satisfy a lint rule would make the evidence less true.
reasons.em-dash-overuse: The privacy annexure is a restatement of the incumbent's policy and uses parenthetical dashes as the source does.

reRunAfterHomeRelayout.when: after the home page was re-laid out to the incumbent site's own section order with plain headings
reRunAfterHomeRelayout.note: numbered-section-labels falls by six because the home page's seven invented Motion/Schedule labels are gone. all-caps-body falls 117 -> 74 because .btn2 was uppercasing sentences and the solutions email address; it is now sentence case.

reported: .band__cell: children flush against border-left on left (no inset)
.band__cell: children flush against border-top/left on left (no inset) x2
.resolution: children flush against bg on top/bottom (no inset)
falsePositives.measured: At 1280px wide, .band__cell after the first renders padding-left: 32px inside a 1px hairline; at 390px the hairline is horizontal and the inset is padding-top: 19.2px; .resolution renders padding-top and padding-bottom of 81.92px.
falsePositives.why: The detector applies narrow-width media-query rules regardless of viewport and does not consistently resolve a later override, so it sees a border with no inset where the browser sees 19-82px. Three attempts to rule out a real defect did not change the finding: the band was given its own cell classes instead of reusing .fact, the cell borders were removed outright, and the clamp() in both bands' padding was moved into root custom properties. Verified with tools/measure-blocks.ps1 reading getComputedStyle.

correctedExceptions.previousDisposition: deliberate — described as "button and control labels"
correctedExceptions.whatWasWrong: The exception was overstated. Auditing the findings instead of trusting the sentence showed .btn2 was uppercased and carrying 40-character sentences ("See all ten roles and both service lines") and the solutions email address, which rendered as SOLUTIONS@STRATASTAFFGLOBAL.COM. Neither is a control label.
correctedExceptions.fix: .btn2 is now sentence case; the primary .btn stays uppercase. Primary and secondary actions are now distinguished by case as well as by fill, so the hierarchy improved rather than regressed.
correctedExceptions.residualRule: No sentence is uppercased anywhere on the site. The tallest uppercase string is now the 32-character primary CTA "Schedule the free discovery call", followed by form field labels (<=21), footer headings (<=17), stamps, address labels and the skip link.
correctedExceptions.verifiedBy: tools/measure-blocks.ps1 -Upper dumps every element the stylesheet uppercases with its rendered text and length, rather than inferring from the CSS.

reRunAfterImagery.when: after the photography was added and the caption sizes were corrected
reRunAfterImagery.note: The new engine adds a tiny-text rule and reports cramped-padding more widely, so the first run after the imagery read 262 against the 242 recorded for 0.1.6. Eleven of the surplus were all-caps-body and one was tiny-text, all from .plate-fig__role, which set the people's job titles in 10.5px uppercase mono. Raising it to 12.5px sentence case and deleting the register overrides that shrank it further returned the total to 242 on the same rule mix as before, with tiny-text at zero.
reRunAfterImagery.caveat: The 242 recorded for 0.1.6 and the 242 recorded for 4.1.0 are not the same measurement: the engines differ. The composition is what matches, not the engine.

knownContentGaps: Maristella Gaton has no usable portrait: the incumbent's own team grid shows her name beside another officer's photograph, verified in the raw markup. Nineteen of twenty names therefore carry a face, and team.html states why the twentieth does not. The pairing of the other nineteen is taken from that same published grid and generated into content/team.json by the asset pass, so it cannot drift from the images that were downloaded.
Strata Executive Assistant has no page in the live sitemap but is listed in the navigation; the role page is built only from real published phrases and its real five training modules.
platform-mri-2.webp returned 404 from the incumbent host; not shipped.
All forms are front-end only and say so on the page.

tools.measureFit: tools/measure-fit.ps1 -Viewports "390x844,1440x900" - all 40 pages: overflow, height in screens, words, sheet fill
tools.measureBlocks: tools/measure-blocks.ps1 -Page index.html [-Selector ".band__grid"] [-Upper] - one page block by block, with computed padding and border; -Upper dumps every uppercase text node with its rendered text
tools.detectAll: strata-scan/detect-all.mjs - re-run the detector over all 40 pages, summarised by rule
tools.detectShow: strata-scan/detect-show.mjs <rule> - the detail behind one rule's findings
tools.srcsetCheck: tools/srcset-check.mjs - walks every srcset candidate, <link href> and CSS url() and checks each against disk, then names every shipped image nothing points at. Closes the gap where a build could validate src and ship a broken 800w candidate.
tools.detectJson: tools/detect-json.mjs - runs the detector and parses its JSON without a shell redirect, which corrupts the stream with a BOM and the wrong code page.
tools.optimise: strata-scan/optimise.py - crops every portrait around its own measured face and writes content/team.json.

weightCameFrom: exec-*.jpg re-encoded to WebP at two widths: 6.79MB -> 1.10MB (-84%)
team portraits replaced at 480x640, -70% each on average
33 files removed from assets/ after proving nothing in any shipped page or stylesheet pointed at them
imagery.sourcesMovedNotDeleted: The 14 Model-*.webp and exec-*.jpg originals plus the 2 unused section panels moved to strata-scan/raw-portrait/, because optimise.py reads them and deleting them would make the asset pass unreproducible. Re-running the optimiser from the new folder reproduces every shipped file byte for byte with zero MISSING entries.
imagery.framing: Faces sit 27%-66% down the frame (skin-tone centroid, faces.py; found in 31/31, median 56%), so no single object-position works: cropping for the median decapitates the outliers. Each image is cropped to its target aspect around its own measured face at build time (optimise.py), and the stylesheet carries no object-position at all.
imagery.identity: Named people and role photographs are separate sets. The 19 people carry names the incumbent publishes beside those exact portraits. The 8 Model-*.webp photographs carry NO published personal name, so they are captioned by role and no identity is invented for them.
imagery.roleCoverage: 8 of the 10 role pages carry a photograph; insurance-specialist and pm-customer-care have no matching photograph and keep the stamp rather than borrowing another role's face.
imagery.unusedReason: Both are 768x768 composed panels with low edge energy and a large dark middle band: designed panels carrying their own type, not photographs. The sections that would have held them use real named people instead.

verifiedAfterImagery.note: The home page is 3.5 screens longer than the 7.0 recorded in §11. That is the deliberate trade: the request was "too much text", and the response replaced prose with 52 images rather than deleting sections the incumbent's site carries.
